\caption{X-M on an LVIS subset (descriptive; Qwen3.5-9B, F1 $\times$100). Descriptive only (preregistration XM-2b): an LVIS v1 val subset of 1,000 images with at most 3 positive categories per image (chosen by hash rank), 2,213 (image, category) pairs over 446 categories. The images are COCO val2017 images outside the three COCO splits, so none is an X-M training image. For categories not exhaustively annotated in an image (LVIS not\_exhaustive), unmatched predictions are ignored (LVIS convention). Metrics, rows and columns as in the main X-M table: F1 $\times$100 = Rex-Omni's class-macro F1 at IoU 0.5; per-row CIs: 95\% bootstrap over images from each run (1,000 resamples); Main $-$ row: paired bootstrap over images, 95\%, 10,000 resamples (seed 20260929); -- = not applicable. No entry is in bold. External reference: Rex-Omni (IDEA-Research/Rex-Omni at 0e5693d), a detector built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, i.e. a learned vision model; run by us separately with its official prompts, preprocessing and parsing (deviations recorded with the run, D178), detection only; its outputs are used only for scoring, never in our data or training. Joint = its own protocol: one query per image listing all the image's positive categories. X-M $-$ Rex-Omni (joint): +2.7 [+0.8, +4.1] points. Rex-Omni's training data may overlap with LVIS, so this difference is a description, not a conclusion. Per category = X-M's protocol (one query per (image, category)), a diagnostic: X-M $-$ Rex-Omni +2.8 [+0.8, +4.1] points. On the LVIS subset, the spline rasterised directly, without snapping to image edges, is 3.3 points [+2.3, +4.1] below the main setting. LVIS subset: 109 of 5,086 predicted instances (2.1\%) fall back to boxes → GrabCut in the main setting, because call 2 returned a different number of splines than boxes (D168). Data: RUN-0111 (Rex-Omni; hpcgpu06); RUN-0112 (X-M, base; hpcgpu07); X-M and the base model on the same node (D93-1); Rex-Omni, an external reference, on hpcgpu06 (D180); readings and paired differences from xm\_results.json (computed in RUN-0113 on CPU).}
